facts.text: The module provides basic control of AFG1000 and AFG3000 series Tektronix arbitrary function generators
FuncGen exposes two channels, ch1 and ch2, as FuncGenChannel objects
The channel command prefix is SOURceN:
The frequency limits are selected from the connected model: AFG1022 and AFG3022 allow 1e-6 to 25e6 Hz, AFG1062 allows 1e-6 to 60e6 Hz
The amplitude limits also depend on the impedance: AFG1022 50 ohm 0.001 to 10 Vpp and highZ 0.002 to 20 Vpp; AFG3022 50 ohm 0.01 to 10 Vpp and highZ 0.02 to 20 Vpp
The output impedance (50 ohm or high Z) cannot be controlled or read remotely
The frequency limits are those of a sine; other functions may have a lower limit
The output state query returns 0 for OFF and 1 for ON
The channel settings map converts the output state 0 or 1 to OFF or ON
The output is set with OUTPutN:STATe
The function is read with SOURceN:FUNCtion:SHAPe?
The function is set with SOURceN:FUNCtion:SHAPe <shape>
The function setter documents SINusoid, SQUare, PULSe, RAMP, PRNoise, built-in shapes and DC
The README sets the channel function to SIN
The amplitude is read with SOURceN:VOLTage:AMPLitude?
The amplitude is set with SOURceN:VOLTage:LEVel <amplitude>Vpp
The offset is read with SOURceN:VOLTage:OFFSet?
The offset is set with SOURceN:VOLTage:LEVel:OFFSet <offset>V
The frequency is read with SOURceN:FREQuency?
The frequency is set with SOURceN:FREQuency:FIXed <freq>Hz
A channel set_settings turns the channel off, applies function, amplitude, offset and frequency, then restores the output state
Frequency lock is read with SOURCE1:FREQuency:CONCurrent?
Frequency lock is set with SOURCE{use_channel}:FREQuency:CONCurrent <state>
The waveform catalogue is read with DATA:CATalog?
The error queue is read with SYSTEM:ERROR:NEXT?

operator_required.name: amplitude_ch1
operator_required.reason: the clone selects the amplitude range from the connected model and the impedance setting (tektronix_func_gen.py:214-267), and the impedance cannot be read remotely (README.md:197-200); the site supplies the amplitude range of its generator output

operator_required.name: amplitude_ch2
operator_required.reason: the clone selects the amplitude range from the connected model and the impedance setting (tektronix_func_gen.py:214-267), and the impedance cannot be read remotely (README.md:197-200); the site supplies the amplitude range of its generator output

operator_required.name: offset_ch1
operator_required.reason: the clone checks the offset against the voltage limits of the connected model and the impedance setting (tektronix_func_gen.py:1188-1201), and the impedance cannot be read remotely (README.md:197-200); the site supplies the offset range of its installation

operator_required.name: offset_ch2
operator_required.reason: the clone checks the offset against the voltage limits of the connected model and the impedance setting (tektronix_func_gen.py:1188-1201), and the impedance cannot be read remotely (README.md:197-200); the site supplies the offset range of its installation

operator_required.name: frequency_ch1
operator_required.reason: the clone selects the frequency range from the connected model (tektronix_func_gen.py:214-267), and its limits are those of a sine, not every function (README.md:29-31); the site supplies the range of its generator and waveform

operator_required.name: frequency_ch2
operator_required.reason: the clone selects the frequency range from the connected model (tektronix_func_gen.py:214-267), and its limits are those of a sine, not every function (README.md:29-31); the site supplies the range of its generator and waveform
